pandas.DataFrame.duplicated

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Mark repeated values or rows with a boolean mask. Use keep=False to mark every member of a duplicate set.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.duplicated(subset=None, keep='first')
